tier_a._comment: 5 canonical questions, each with 4 high-similarity paraphrases. All worded to AVOID the cache's crisis/personal bypass tokens so first seed = MISS, subsequent = HIT.

clusters.q: What is the refund and cancellation policy for passenger tickets?
v: Can you explain how passenger ticket refunds and cancellations work?
How does the refund process apply to cancelled passenger tickets?
What happens to the fare when a passenger ticket is cancelled?
What are the terms for refunding and cancelling passenger tickets?

clusters.q: What documents are required to book a senior citizen concession ticket?
v: Which documents do senior citizens need for a concession ticket booking?
What proof is needed to avail the senior citizen fare concession?
How can senior citizens submit the required documents for a concession ticket?
What paperwork is mandatory for the senior citizen concession on tickets?

clusters.q: How can a passenger change the journey date after booking?
v: What is the process to reschedule the travel date on a booked ticket?
Are passengers allowed to modify the travel date after purchase?
How does the date-change option work for confirmed tickets?
Can the journey date be changed once the ticket is booked?

clusters.q: Which items are prohibited inside the waiting rooms?
v: What luggage items are not allowed in the waiting rooms?
Are there restricted items for passengers in the waiting area?
What is banned inside the passenger waiting rooms?
Which objects cannot be carried into the waiting rooms?

clusters.q: How does the tatkal reservation quota work for trains?
v: What is the tatkal quota and how does it apply to bookings?
How are tatkal tickets reserved on trains?
What are the rules for the tatkal reservation scheme?
Can passengers book under the tatkal quota for any train?

tier_b._comment: High-entropy cold queries: {uuid}/{date} tokens are substituted at run time to guarantee MISS.
templates: What is the current status of booking reference {uuid}?
Explain the fare difference for route {uuid} across dates {date}.
Which express trains on route {uuid} have rescheduled stops this week?
